## getLogger() function

Get the singleton logger instance.

Creates a default logger on first call. Use [setLogger()](./runtime.setlogger.md) to replace the singleton with a custom instance.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function getLogger(): pino.Logger
```

**Returns:**

pino.Logger

The singleton Pino logger
